name: Internal — improvement task
description: Controller stage: a planner scopes one task and a worker implements it. The controller supplies the task packet and owns checks, review and revisions.

roles.name: Lead Planner
roles.instructions: Inspect the assigned task packet and state concrete implementation constraints, risks, and acceptance criteria. Do not edit files and do not change orchestration state.

roles.name: Worker
roles.instructions: Implement the assigned task completely inside the declared scope, using the Lead plan as input. Do not run acceptance, integration, E2E, database, Docker, browser, or other shared-resource checks. Do not change orchestration state.

steps.name: Lead plans the assigned task
steps.promptTemplate:
Work only on the assigned task packet below. Inspect the repository and state concrete implementation constraints, risks, and acceptance criteria. Do not edit files. The deterministic controller owns checks, review, and integration.

{{userPrompt}}

steps.name: Worker implements the assigned task
